tests.command: python -m coverage run --source=src -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml="$A2DLC_JUNIT" $A2DLC_TESTS; python -m coverage xml -q -o "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"
tests.baseline_command: python -m coverage run --source=src -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml="$A2DLC_JUNIT" tests; python -m coverage xml -q -o "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"
